## User need

Who needs this, and which current workflow is difficult?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected result and how we would know it works. Reference the roadmap if relevant.

## Alternatives and boundaries

Describe alternatives, accessibility needs, regional differences, privacy/permission implications and any operational requirements. Use fictional examples; do not include personal medical information.
